text:
Silver Price in 2022
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2022, the LBMA silver price rose 6.4% between 2022-01-31 ($22.50) and 2022-12-30 ($23.95). The highest sampled price was $24.82 in March and the lowest was $17.95 in August. The mean of these observations was $21.58. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2022:
The highest inflation in four decades and aggressive rate hikes produced volatile, range-bound metals prices.
